notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1094070_city_of_cairo.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. At 5,150 m in the South Atlantic, some 480 miles south of St Helena: broken in two, both halves deep in the silt with mud heaped on them, the houses fallen in, masts and funnel gone, the torpedo hole aft. The silver was raised in 2013. The break, the burial, the heading (not published here: 0) and the catalog pin are approximate. model_built.glb: the liner as she was in 1942. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
